programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Patrick and Squidward must survive together in the woods in 'Squisery', and in 'Game Night', The adults sneak away to play a board game, but they have to hide from one camper in particular.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward's prankster dad visits in 'Jeffy T's Prankwell Emporium', then in 'A Taste of Plankton', Plankton replaces SpongeBob's tongue.

programme.desc: Patrick and Squidina take care of Granny Tentacles' house in 'Two Pests in a Teapot', then in 'Partial Recall', the Dartfish family adopts Plankton after he forgets who he is.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Sandy takes on SpongeBob in a non-stop week of extreme sports in "Prehibernation Week.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Pat The Hapless goes on a barbaric quest to the shopping mall in 'Chopping Spree', then in 'All Bot Myself', after Captain Quasar buys a new robot, Pat-Tron works for the Star family.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Krabs wants to give his daughter the best birthday ever in 'Whale of a Birthday', then in 'Karate Island', SpongeBob gets an invitation to take part in a competition to be crowned King of Karate.

programme.title: Kamp Koral

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Plankton replaces the Chum Bucket with a Roman coliseum (and togas!) in 'Spongicus', and then in 'Suctioncup Symphony', Squidward is sure to win a music contest - if SpongeBob and Patrick stay quiet.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward cleans up the city of Bikini Bottom with help from SpongeBob in 'Keep Bikini Bottom Beautiful', and then in 'A Pal for Gary', SpongeBob brings Gary a pet that terrorizes him.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick presents a show about food after missing out on a hearty breakfast in 'Late for Breakfast', then in 'Bummer Jobs', Patrick and SpongeBob experience the wonders of the workforce.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick and SpongeBob work at the movie theatre to watch a new premiere in 'Movie Stars', then in 'Dr. Smart Science', Sandy helps Patrick to host a science show.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: All is quiet while SpongeBob is 'House Sitting for Sandy' - until Patrick shows up! And in 'Smooth Jazz at Bikini Bottom', SpongeBob and Squidward try to sneak backstage at the Kelpy G concert.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick think their homes have been sold, and move away, to Squidward's glee, in 'Sold!', and in 'Lame and Fortune', Plankton realises he can twist fortune cookies to suit his evil plot.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Sandy creates a new invention to avoid doing chores in 'Are You Smarter Than A Smart Cabin', and then in 'Deep Sea Despot', Squidward takes over as Camp Master.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Patrick's dad unexpectedly visits Kamp Koral in 'Help Not Wanted', then in 'Camp Spirit', SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy befriend a visiting ghost camper.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick believes he's a medical professional in 'Doctor Patrick', and in 'Slumber Party Stars', after Pearl can no longer sleepover with Squidina, the Stars throw Squidina a slumber party.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick hosts an award ceremony in 'The Starry Awards', and then in 'Blorpsgiving', Captain Doug Quasar meets Pat-Tron's robot family.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Krabs tries to sabotage the circus in 'Big Top Flop', then in 'Sandy, Help Us!', Sandy spends the day solving everyone's issues, only to return home to her own monster of a problem.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Karen tells the fairytale of a nerd trying to steal an action figure in 'Big Bad Bubble Bass', then in 'Sea-Man Sponge Haters Club', Squidward hosts a secret We Hate SpongeBob Club at his house.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: GrandPat competes for Granny Tentacles' love on a dating game show in 'The Dated Game', then in 'Ice Cream Headache', The Ice Cream Man and Ice Cream King team up to capture an icy beast.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Granny Tentacles helps Squidward collect his paper delivery money from Cecil in 'Backpay Payback', then in 'House Hunting', The Star family house runs away from home.

programme.desc: Patrick helps with Squidward's paper route in 'Pat-per Route', then in 'Day of the Dartfish', The Dartfish family finds a thief.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: The Sharks are the toughest guys in town, but their next confrontation might be too much in 'Sharks vs. Pods', and then in 'CopyBob DittoPants', Plankton clones SpongeBob to steal the secret formula.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Patrick decides it's time to start living life like Larry the Lobster in 'A Life In A Day', and then in 'Sun Bleached', SpongeBob tries to get a tan, with disappointing results.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs wishes he could talk to money in 'Money Talks', and then in 'SpongeBob vs the Patty Gadget', SpongeBob battles a patty-making machine. Plus there's a dance contest in 'Slimy Dancing'.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Bikini Bottom think that SpongeBob is a monster in 'The Thing', and then in 'Hocus Pocus', SpongeBob tries to impress Squidward with his new magic kit.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Sandy is out of town for a few days so SpongeBob and Patrick are pet sitting for her in "Wormy.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr Krabs joins in a game of treasure hunt with SpongeBob and Patrick In 'Arrgh!', while in 'Rock Bottom' SpongeBob gets on the wrong bus and finds himself in a strange town.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob takes it up a notch and tries to show how rugged he is, in 'No Weenies Allowed', and then in 'Squilliam Returns', Squidward tells a big fib to impress his arch nemesis.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob is determined to have a great day in 'The Best Day Ever', and then in 'The Gift Of Gum', Patrick gives SpongeBob a gift - an enormous ball of used chewing gum. Best present ever.

programme.desc: Plankton disguises himself as SpongeBob's grandmother in 'Gramma's Secret Recipe', and then in 'The Cent Of Money', Mr Krabs uses Gary to find spare change.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick find buried treasure in 'The Treasure of Kamp Koral', then in 'Camper Gary', SpongeBob disguises Gary as a new camper to keep him safe from Mrs. Puff.

programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick compete to be camp mascot in 'Mascot Mayhem', then in 'Putt Up or Shut Up', Krabs and Squidward play the most dangerous game.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: The Dinghies travel to outer space in 'Hats Off to Space', then in 'In a Nut's Shell', After discovering his empty shell, Narlene and Nobby disguise themselves at Camp Master Krabs.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.desc: SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy decide to turn their cabin into a pirate ship in 'Camp Crossbones', then in 'A Jelly Life', SpongeBob pretends to be a jellyfish for research purposes.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Puff gives swimming lessons to Patrick in 'Pat's A Li'l Sinker', then in 'Camp SpongeBob', SpongeBob finds himself all alone in the camp, but that doesn't stop him from having a blast.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Nobby becomes too civilized for Narlene in 'My Fair Nobby', and in 'Gimme a News Break', Perch and his pal Harvey report the news of Kamp Koral, but they discover evidence of a conspiracy.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Perch Perkins is replaced by a robot in 'Smartificial Intelligence', then in 'Firehouse Bob', SpongeBob becomes a fireman.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick hosts a countrified variety show. in 'Sea Haw', then in 'Li'l Past-cals', The Kelpbed Kids travel to the future to get their kicking can back.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.desc: A young SpongeBob is determined to catch his first jellyfish, so his friends do whatever they can to help him.
